meta.name: Dating Disasters
meta.description:
Finding love is hard, and keeping that love alive is even harder! Don’t miss a single date, shouting match or tossed wine glass from TV’s best reality shows, 24 hours a day.

Shows: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D & Vinny, Baggage, Rock of Love: Duet To Me One More Time, Rock of Love: Exes and Ohs!, Rock of Love: Double Dates
Available on: Pluto TV
